name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo Alonso's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, sparked by watching Fernando Alonso's dominance. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, followed by a master's in management, combining his technical acumen with leadership skills. Before stepping into the role of Team Principal, Ricardo honed his skills as a race engineer and then as head of strategy, gaining invaluable insights into team dynamics and car development.

Ricardo believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's contribution is valued. His approach is data-driven, but he also trusts his intuition and experience, fostering a blend of analytical precision and creative problem-solving. He is known for his ability to stay calm under pressure and make decisive calls, making him a reliable leader in the high-stakes world of motorsport. What distinguishes Ricardo is his focus on continuous improvement and an unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of performance.
